compute: All candidate search, routing, comparisons and engineering calculations on dislab CPU
model: Unchanged H13 recent CFM,128 marginal samples; no fitting, normalization, calibration, threshold/model/distribution selection using API

automatic_candidates.selection: All supported sites scanned. Receivers ranked by frozen marginal benefit/(1+air km from depot); donors by air depot-to-donor + nearest shortlisted receiver distance. Add legacy default ids, unique pool<=29; shortlist is a heuristic, not citywide optimality.

policy.source: H17 conservative bound: min(current-target, empirical10percentile-target, allsample minimum,6), floored/clipped at0
policy.drop: min(3,ceil(target-empirical10percentile)); assumed parking acceptance, not verified capacity
policy.station_loss: E[max(target-(sample+net),0)] +2*P(sample+net<=0); additive marginal loss, not joint city scenario
policy.cost_order: km,minutes,moved bikes; fixed operational preferences, not API-trained parameters
policy.search: Deterministic beam width64, max6 unique station visits, all integer quantities, donor-first load constraints; always include noaction, exhaustive feasible2stop quantities and feasible legacy H17 as fallback; no global optimality claim
policy.resources: One empty-start/empty-return vehicle; capacity1..12, moved budget1..12; handling.1min/bike; road directed OSRM driving estimates; confirmed real resources absent
policy.time: Departure at calibrated remote calculation start. Effective allowed route=min(operator1..10min,target-minus-departure-minus30sec). Never extend forecast horizon; reject expired source/clock/version. Issuance must still allow route completion before target.

evaluation.fixed_departure: For paired offline diagnostic comparisons, obs+10sec, deadline=min(10,remaining forecast horizon minus30sec); same state/resources/depot/all-city loss. Separately actual serving uses current calibrated clock.
baseline: legacy fixed5 exact H17 where feasible
best feasible nearest donor/receiver pair with all integer quantities
evaluation.primary: acceptance failures: feasible conservation/capacity/current source/donor safety/deadline and no selected score worse than feasible fallback under same all-city loss; require>=1 strict improvement over legacy on3states to support practical expansion
evaluation.oracle: At least20 seeded small cases <=4 candidate sites; exhaustive enumeration with same marginal objective; preserve beam gaps, no exactness assertion
evaluation.latency: Report cold road latency separately from warm solver; default3snapshots; no latency tuning
evaluation.success: zero acceptance failures,3 live state comparisons completed,>=1 strict improvement versus legacy. Otherwise not_supported/inconclusive; do not retune on API.
evaluation.limits: Benefits are model-based marginal coverage proxies, not observed shortage prevention, lost demand reduction, or true fleet optimum

operations: Bounded watcher reacts once per new H18 state and saves default shadow plans; private cached routing; changed constraints/source version recompute. UI automatic mode default, manual override, unserved/covered counts and actionable noaction reason. No actual dispatch or operator messages.
